description: This file defines types, utility functions, and validation logic for external plugin compatibility and package JSON validation within the openclaw project.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a JsonObject (non-array object).

methods.name: getTrimmedString
methods.description: Returns a trimmed string if input is a non-empty string, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: readOpenClawBlock
methods.description: Extracts nested openclaw-related objects from a packageJson.

methods.name: normalizeExternalPluginCompatibility
methods.description: Creates a compatibility object based on packageJson fields, normalizing version info.

methods.name: listMissingExternalCodePluginFieldPaths
methods.description: Returns list of required fields missing in packageJson.

methods.name: validateExternalCodePluginPackageJson
methods.description: Validates packageJson for required fields and returns issues and compatibility info.
